proof_body:
by
  intro Ω _ _ _ n k A hk
  have h : (Fintype.card Ω : ℝ) ≠ 0 := by exact_mod_cast Fintype.card_ne_zero
  have hA : (Aᶜ.card : ℝ) + A.card = Fintype.card Ω := by exact_mod_cast Finset.card_compl_add_card A
  have e2 : 1 - (A.card : ℝ) / Fintype.card Ω = (Aᶜ.card : ℝ) / Fintype.card Ω := by
    field_simp; linarith
  have count : (Finset.univ.filter (fun ω : Fin n → Ω => (Finset.univ.filter (fun i => ω i ∈ A)).card = k)).card = n.choose k * (A.card ^ k * Aᶜ.card ^ (n - k)) := by
    have hmaps : ∀ ω ∈ Finset.univ.filter (fun ω : Fin n → Ω => (Finset.univ.filter (fun i => ω i ∈ A)).card = k), Finset.univ.filter (fun i => ω i ∈ A) ∈ Finset.powersetCard k (Finset.univ : Finset (Fin n)) := by
      intro ω hω
      simp only [Finset.mem_filter, Finset.mem_univ, true_and] at hω
      exact Finset.mem_powersetCard.mpr ⟨Finset.subset_univ _, hω⟩
    rw [Finset.card_eq_sum_card_fiberwise hmaps]
    have hfib : ∀ S ∈ Finset.powersetCard k (Finset.univ : Finset (Fin n)), ((Finset.univ.filter (fun ω : Fin n → Ω => (Finset.univ.filter (fun i => ω i ∈ A)).card = k)).filter (fun ω => Finset.univ.filter (fun i => ω i ∈ A) = S)).card = A.card ^ k * Aᶜ.card ^ (n - k) := by
      intro S hS
      have hSc : S.card = k := (Finset.mem_powersetCard.mp hS).2
      have e : (Finset.univ.filter (fun ω : Fin n → Ω => (Finset.univ.filter (fun i => ω i ∈ A)).card = k)).filter (fun ω => Finset.univ.filter (fun i => ω i ∈ A) = S) = Fintype.piFinset (fun i => if i ∈ S then A else Aᶜ) := by
        ext ω
        simp only [Finset.mem_filter, Finset.mem_univ, true_and, Fintype.mem_piFinset]
        constructor
        · rintro ⟨_, hω⟩ i
          by_cases hi : i ∈ S
          · rw [if_pos hi]
            rw [← hω] at hi
            simpa using hi
          · rw [if_neg hi, Finset.mem_compl]
            intro hh
            apply hi
            rw [← hω]
            simpa using hh
        · intro hω
          have hS' : Finset.univ.filter (fun i => ω i ∈ A) = S := by
            ext i
            simp only [Finset.mem_filter, Finset.mem_univ, true_and]
            constructor
            · intro hi
              by_contra hn
              have := hω i
              rw [if_neg hn, Finset.mem_compl] at this
              exact this hi
            · intro hi
              have := hω i
              rwa [if_pos hi] at this
          exact ⟨by rw [hS', hSc], hS'⟩
      have hi : ∀ i : Fin n, (if i ∈ S then A else Aᶜ).card = if i ∈ S then A.card else Aᶜ.card := by
        intro i; split_ifs <;> rfl
      rw [e, Fintype.card_piFinset, Finset.prod_congr rfl (fun i _ => hi i), Finset.prod_ite, Finset.prod_const, Finset.prod_const]
      have c1 : (Finset.univ.filter (fun i => i ∈ S)).card = k := by
        rw [Finset.filter_mem_eq_inter, Finset.univ_inter, hSc]
      have c2 : (Finset.univ.filter (fun i => i ∉ S)).card = n - k := by
        have := Finset.card_filter_add_card_filter_not (s := (Finset.univ : Finset (Fin n))) (fun i => i ∈ S)
        rw [c1, Finset.card_univ, Fintype.card_fin] at this
        omega
      rw [c1, c2]
    rw [Finset.sum_congr rfl hfib, Finset.sum_const, Finset.card_powersetCard, Finset.card_univ, Fintype.card_fin, smul_eq_mul]
  rw [count, e2, Fintype.card_fun, Fintype.card_fin, div_pow, div_pow]
  have hk' : (Fintype.card Ω : ℝ) ^ n = (Fintype.card Ω : ℝ) ^ k * (Fintype.card Ω : ℝ) ^ (n - k) := by
    rw [← pow_add, Nat.add_sub_cancel' hk]
  push_cast
  rw [hk']
  have hp1 : (Fintype.card Ω : ℝ) ^ k ≠ 0 := pow_ne_zero k h
  have hp2 : (Fintype.card Ω : ℝ) ^ (n - k) ≠ 0 := pow_ne_zero _ h
  field_simp
target_source: ∀ (Ω : Type*) [Fintype Ω] [DecidableEq Ω] [Nonempty Ω] (n k : ℕ) (A : Finset Ω), k ≤ n → ((Finset.univ.filter (fun ω : Fin n → Ω => (Finset.univ.filter (fun i => ω i ∈ A)).card = k)).card : ℝ) / Fintype.card (Fin n → Ω) = (n.choose k : ℝ) * ((A.card : ℝ) / Fintype.card Ω) ^ k * (1 - (A.card : ℝ) / Fintype.card Ω) ^ (n - k)
